To reach the next level, quantify mission and design requirements, add contingency and software/licensing detail, and show actual STK/design results rather than tutorial completion. Presentation also needs a captioned Gantt and consistent citations." Count ~55 words. Good.

C2: "Your Gantt/timetable and listed sources make the plan credible.
